privacy.title: Privacy statement
privacy.intro: This page explains what data the forms on this site collect and how it is used. The site does not use cookies.

sections.title: Who we are
body: The data controller is Children's Academy private school. Contact details are on the Contact page.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Admission form: parent's name, phone number, (optional) child's name, target grade, language and message text.
Olympiads, quizzes, assessments and psychology tests: participant name, grade, answers and results; contact details for olympiad registration.
Brain-game leaderboard: the nickname you enter and your score. We recommend not using a real name.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To answer your request, register participation, issue results and certificates and score tests. Data is never used for advertising, sold or shared with third parties.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
body: The site does not use cookies. Only convenience settings stay in your browser storage: theme (light/dark), language and test progress. Visit statistics are anonymous page views that do not identify a person.

sections.title: Children's data
body: Children's data is collected through a parent or legal guardian, or with their permission. We ask only for the minimum needed. Psychology test results are not a diagnosis, are informational only and are not shared with third parties without consent.
A parent can ask at any time to view, correct or delete their child's data.

sections.title: Storage and security
body: Data is stored in a protected database and only authorised staff can access it. A notification about new admission requests may be sent to the admissions office. Data is not kept longer than the purpose requires.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may access, correct or delete your data and withdraw consent. To make a request, use the e-mail or phone number on the Contact page.
